ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a unstructured grid type and 0.5 x 0.5 degree resolution.
description: The native ILS land grid contains 120964 distinct model cells with positive effective area: 94427 unit-catchment elements shared by MATSIRO and CaMa-Flood in the river-bearing domain and 26537 additional non-river elements used by MATSIRO. Catchment and non-river supports are represented by labelled pixels on a geographic one-arcminute raster. A real non-river contribution consists of non-catchment land within its 0.5-degree address rectangle. A virtual non-river contribution uses a weighted ocean-class support to supply additional effective land area required for consistency with the ocean-derived land area on the atmospheric grid. Real and virtual contributions can share one non-river cell ID and are combined into that cell's area; they are not counted as separate cells. This is an unstructured collection of catchment and masked or weighted land elements, not a uniform rectangular physical mesh. The native cell count excludes storage padding. The 360 by 720 river address array and MATSIRO's concatenated 720 by 720 river/non-river storage array do not define physical cell widths and are separate from the two land-cover tiles. Exchanges between MATSIRO and CaMa-Flood over the shared river domain use one-to-one cell correspondence without spatial remapping or aggregation. The 3600-second exchange interval, AVR and lag=-1 settings describe separate temporal treatment. Published land fields are subsequently remapped to the regular 0.5-degree output grid g131.
